title: The influence of microinjection parameters on cell survival and procedure efficiency
author: Hajduk, Szajna, et al.
materials: The MEF 3T3 cell line (Mouse Embryonic Fibroblasts, ATCC CRL-1658) was cultured in DMEM Low Glucose medium (Dulbecco's Modified Eagle Medium; Biowest, France) supplemented with 10% FBS (Fetal Bovine Serum; ThermoFisher Scientific, USA) and 1% PS (penicillin and streptomycin; Biowest, France) at 37 °C, 5% CO2. Cells used in these experiments had between third and thirteenth passage.

One day prior to the experiments, cells were seeded in 35 mm cell imaging glass bottom dishes (thickness #1.5) (Cellvis, USA). Cells that were placed overnight in the incubator for survival test, were seeded in a 35 mm gridded glass bottom dish (Cellvis, USA). Cells were imagined in FluoroBriteTM DMEM medium (ThermoFisher Scientific, USA) supplemented with 2% FBS, 1% PS, 1% 200 mM L-glutamine (ThermoFisher Scientific, USA) and 1% sodium pyruvate 100 mM (EuroClone, Italy).

steps.title: Maintain MEF 3T3 culture
steps.instruction: Culture MEF 3T3 cells (ATCC CRL‑1658) in DMEM Low Glucose (Biowest) supplemented with 10 % FBS (ThermoFisher) and 1 % penicillin‑streptomycin (Biowest) at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂; use cells between passage 3 and 13.

steps.title: Seed cells in glass dishes
steps.instruction: One day before injection, seed cells into 35 mm cell‑imaging glass‑bottom dishes (thickness #1.5, Cellvis). For overnight survival tests, seed cells in 35 mm gridded glass‑bottom dishes (Cellvis).

steps.title: Prepare imaging medium
steps.instruction: Replace culture medium with FluoroBrite™ DMEM (ThermoFisher) containing 2 % FBS, 1 % penicillin‑streptomycin, 1 % 200 mM L‑glutamine (ThermoFisher) and 1 % sodium pyruvate 100 mM (EuroClone) before imaging.

steps.title: Load micropipette with dextran
steps.instruction: Load each micropipette with 2 µL dextran using Microloader™ tips (Eppendorf).

steps.title: Position micropipette over cells
steps.instruction: Mount the loaded micropipette in the grip head, attach to the capillary holder, place in the microscope light path, and lower with the micromanipulator until the tip is directly above the cells under a 10× objective; then switch to a 40× objective.

steps.title: Set pressures and needle angle
steps.instruction: Apply a minimal compensation pressure (pc) to produce a small dextran leak. For semi‑automatic injection, set injection pressure (pi) to approximately twice pc and orient the needle at 45°. In manual mode, use a lower pi as needed.

steps.title: Determine optimal injection pressure
steps.instruction: Microinject a few test cells while varying pi; visually identify the lowest pressure that yields successful injection and adopt that pressure for the experiment.

steps.title: Inject cells
steps.instruction: Inject the remaining cells using the chosen manual or semi‑automatic mode, maintaining the previously determined injection pressure and needle angle.
